closure_status_classification.description: Classification schema for mathematical closure states.

classes.description: Theorem or closure holds within a defined local scope or finite parameter set.
Closure is possible but requires missing formalization (removable incompleteness).
Closure depends on limits that cannot be reached through finite induction or simulation.
Information loss in projection operators prevents unique inversion or global mapping.
Intrinsic operator properties (many-to-one) forbid unique reconstruction of causal history.
Primitive branching dynamics forbid unique global continuation selection.
Singular behavior at parameter boundaries prevents exact formal closure at those points.
Candidate for formal proof of impossibility; claim violates core framework axioms or scope.
